shots.name: hook
shots.prompt: Three members of an estate committee, Nigerian men and women aged thirty-five to sixty, well dressed, sit around a table in the estate clubhouse, one turning a laptop towards the others with a smile. Palms visible through the window. Soft daylight. Laptop screen facing away from camera, hands relaxed on the table.

shots.name: why
shots.prompt: A confident Nigerian estate security lead in a neat uniform and a well-dressed female estate manager talk at the gatehouse of a gated Abuja estate, both smiling, hands relaxed. Barrier arm and palms behind. Warm morning light.

shots.name: tip
shots.prompt: A thoughtful, elegant Nigerian woman in her fifties, the estate chairperson, sits at her desk in a home study in a gated estate, reviewing something on her laptop with a calm, careful expression. Bookshelf and window onto palms. Soft daylight, lower third of the frame in shade. Laptop screen facing away from camera.
